mentions.name: macOS key combo viewer
mentions.description: A macOS app that displays key combinations at once, designed to be useful for people who use macros or custom key combinations on custom keyboards. The author built it because they wanted such a tool but couldn't find one anywhere.
mentions.problem: No existing app let the author see key combos at once — they wanted one but couldn't find it anywhere.
mentions.audience: Mostly people who use macros or key combinations on a custom keyboard, for whom the author says no similar app could be found anywhere yet.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a macOS app that lets you see key combos at once, mostly useful if you use macros or key-combinations on a custom keyboard. It's something that I really wanted but couldn't find anywhere yet.

evidence.value: I'm working on a macOS app that lets you see key combos at once, mostly useful if you use macros or key-combinations on a custom keyboard. It's something that I really wanted but couldn't find anywhere yet.
